response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM order_counts), kept AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count, oa.avg_count FROM order_counts AS oc CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa WHERE oc.order_count > oa.avg_count), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM kept) SELECT k.account_id, k.order_count, k.order_count - k.avg_count AS above_overall_average, k.order_count - ka.avg_count AS above_kept_average FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_avg AS ka ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC, k.account_id LIMIT 10;
